taxonomy_note: One primary software parent per node; README/commits/API evidence, with reverse-ported features, merge-back, shared platform code and influence represented as lateral edges. Renames stored as aliases on same node.

policy.primary_parent: Exactly one evidenced primary ancestor of the instrument itself: GitHub fork parent, shared historical commit, author README or owner description stating the instrument derives from another work. Platform, BSP or library dependency does not qualify.
policy.fork: GitHub fork metadata indicates repository genealogy, not necessarily music or functionality.
policy.git_submodule: Pinned submodule from .gitmodules and gitlink proves a precise dependency. It is primary ancestry only when the submodule is the instrument firmware the work is built from; a shared base, BSP or library submodule is a component edge.
policy.git_commit: Preserved ancestor commit gives historical common Git ancestry.
policy.readme: First-party project README asserts origin. Not proof of retained Git commit history.
policy.repo_description: First-party description, lower confidence than Git ancestry.
policy.horizontal: Code uptake, BSP and platform reuse not primary instrument ancestry.
policy.candidate: External catalogue hypotheses retained as suggestions, not inserted into the tree.
policy.unresolved: Lack of established ancestor does not imply independently written code.
policy.uptake: Actual source code/engines/implementations adapted from a separate work; source document or code reference required.
policy.influence: Design or measurements explicitly influenced work, without demonstrated copied source; for example Jangada->Felucca BSP dual-core engineering.
policy.shared_code: Byte-identical Git blob across sibling ports; no asserted direction of copying.
policy.upstream_merge: Downstream hardware port accepted/merged into source project by GitHub PR; does not create a second genealogy parent.
policy.aliases: Historical names and transferred repository URLs are synonyms of a node, never new descendants.
policy.port_status: Repository/build/real-device validation state is distinct from a verified origin relationship.
policy.platform: Platform migration (e.g. onto fm1-base) and platform reuse are lateral component edges, never instrument ancestry. felucca-bsp, fm1-base and Felucca-Engines form a separate dependency network.
policy.prehistory: Work before or outside Felucca is kept as separate categories: pre-felucca-research (analysis, tools, prototypes) and stock-firmware-modification (patched or extended M-VAVE firmware). Felucca was created 2026-10-02; these nodes are not Felucca ancestors.
policy.bsp: A BSP extracted from Felucca is recorded as kind bsp with an extraction edge from Felucca. It is not a standalone instrument and is not placed in the instrument tree; works built on it link to it by component edges.
policy.author_country: ISO 3166-1 country code from the location the repository owner gives on their GitHub profile (a place of residence as stated, not nationality); left out when the location is missing or unclear. Database only; not shown on the site.
